name: Graphite stone tile — real photogrammetry-scanned tile material (4K web edition)
method: Photogrammetry scan of a physical tile surface, distributed by ambientCG as Tiles138. The 4K web edition maps are the library's own 4096 x 4096 scans, re-encoded once at high quality for web distribution — no procedural generation, no enlargement, no detail added. The complete native-resolution pack (including the ambient-occlusion map) and a 16K edition prepared from the original scan are hosted on Google Drive (links in the panel). Tile coverage for this set is an estimate from the scanned tile count.
